note: Second blind labeller on ten of the 30 H-B3 unintended misses (owner decision 4 of 2026-11-03), before any publication. Sample: seeded (text hb3-second-labeller-2026-11-03), stratified 5 capability and 5 configuration by the first labeller's label (the configuration class has only six members, so five of six were drawn). The labeller read only a packet per miss (kind, the author's description, the named operation, the files, the engine result, objective facts about the operation and a few of the application's actual answers) and the rule with the legend of blocker codes and a description of the tool and of the setup; it did not see the first labels, which had been committed beforehand (6ee03b2). Per-seed labels stay outside the repository (they paraphrase seed content). The labels are post-measurement judgments of two instances of one model family under a rule written by the implementer; they were not tested by a re-run.

disagreement.kind: a seed of class ordering that the implementer labelled configuration (F1: setup data) and the second labeller capability (C8: the default order applies only when the caller omits the ordering parameter, and the generator sends every query parameter)
disagreement.adjudication: On review the second labeller's reading is the correct one: the implementer missed C8. The registered first labels are kept as the report's primary (24 capability, 6 configuration); adjudicating this one disagreement for the second labeller would give 25 and 5. The other nine labels agree. The same omission (an omitted parameter) could affect other configuration labels that were not in the sample; they were not re-labelled.
